acceptanceCriteria: A DOGFOOD_VERIFY_FILE line longer than 512 characters, or a file with more than 50 lines, is refused before recording with a distinct local-outcome reason and a fix hint naming the limit.
The local-outcome:record-failed row carries a fix hint that points at {evidence}/local-outcome.stderr.
body: Found while binding PR #301 (V1-0019 run-001) on 2026-09-27: one verify line of 1557 characters made the bind report only `local-outcome: record-failed`. The cause is internal/trace/record.go:217, where each verification command is capped at MaxCommandCharacters = 512 (line 25) and at MaxVerificationCommands = 50 (line 24). internal/dogfoodflow/change.go:285 keeps the error text in {evidence}/local-outcome.stderr, but the fix-hint table (change.go:950-970) has no local-outcome:record-failed entry and the verify-file pre-check (unsupported-verify-syntax) checks characters, not length. Diagnosing it took reading source and one abandoned clone.
title: Dogfood bind reports record-failed without naming the 512-character verify-command limit
